name: ext-attack-path-agent
description: High-fidelity external attack-path sweep for Tenable Cloud Security via the tcs MCP connector (Explore/UDM). Reports only running, internet-direct virtual machines whose observed listening service carries a remotely exploitable (AV:N, AC:Low) vulnerability with public evidence (EPSS >= 0.30 OR CISA KEV), correlates the vulnerable component to the exposed port, and tiers findings by cloud-identity blast radius. Writes a self-contained two-tier HTML report; can run daily.
